metadata.description: Eight Claude Code mods. Install only the ones you want.

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Before a shell command deletes or discards files, shows exactly what it would hit and waits for Cancel or Proceed.

plugins.name: time-machine
plugins.description: Snapshots your project right before Claude changes files, so you can roll back to any earlier point with /time-machine.

plugins.name: usage-radar
plugins.description: Shows how much of your Claude plan limits you have used, when they reset, and whether your current pace may reach them first.

plugins.name: agentpane
plugins.description: A side pane listing every helper agent in the session: what it does, how long it has run, and when it finishes.

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: Records every file change Claude makes and plays the changes back frame by frame in a pane (/replay).

plugins.name: screen-cloak
plugins.description: Hides emails, phone numbers, money, account numbers, personal details, passwords and names you list from what is drawn on screen, so you can share your screen. Claude still sees everything.

plugins.name: quest-mode
plugins.description: Turns a goal into a retro RPG quest: Claude does each stage, you give the orders and the verdict, with a pixel map, XP and a boss battle (/quest).

plugins.name: spaceship-bridge
plugins.description: A spaceship bridge for everyday work: Claude as the ship's computer, with a mission display, honest status lights, a captain's log and a results shelf.
